"お金を入れたんですが" means "I put in the money, but..." The verb "入れる" (ireru) means "to put in," and "お金" (okane) means "money." The "たんですが" at the end adds a nuance of explanation or reason, similar to saying "but..." in English. "切符が出ません" means "the ticket is not coming out."
